name: Maihara Suzune
source: A classmate who is popular among boys for her pretty good looks and cheerful behavior. She takes good care of the protagonist, and when she treats the protagonist, who tends to be isolated, with the same attitude, the protagonist catches her attention. She is hard-working and single-minded, and has a tendency to be stubborn when she gets her mind made up.
